detune.unit: normalized; symmetric +/-28*x cents, N=1 zero detune

drive.unit: normalized spectral saturation blend; x squared

gate.unit: boolean held note; falling edge starts release

host_polyphony: one note per instance; up to four same-note detuned oscillators; no chords, intervals or scales
voice_cost: all four oscillators compute; no stack-proportional CPU claim
assets: tablebank.lib generated by generate_morph_tables.py from canonical v2 spectra; hashes mandatory
release: direct exponential, cut after 14 time constants
status: playback-optimization; acceptance follows exact-commit report, not this label
source_of_sound: v2 controls, coefficient bank, phase and articulation; finite phase lookup is approximate
memory: shared rdtable plus any initializer copy; one classInit before any voices, instanceInit per voice
